name: Stock Assessment Graphs (SAG)
description: Stock assessment summaries, reference points and stock status from the ICES Stock Assessment Graphs database.

notes.observation: `StockList?fishStock=` returns 204 No Content for every value tried (stock label `ple.27.420`, StockKey, StockDatabaseID), with or without `year`. Filtering by `assessmentKey` works.

Every record in `StockList` has `ModifiedDate` set to the time of the nightly update (e.g. `20-10-2026 02:00:03`), so `modifiedAfter` returns all assessments. The dates are day-month-year, not ISO 8601.
notes.affects: `getListStocks(modifiedAfter = )` can not find recently changed assessments.

notes.observation: Field names mix PascalCase (`AssessmentKey`, `StockKeyLabel`) and camelCase (`lineNumber`, `fishingPressure`, `settingKey`), sometimes within one endpoint.
notes.affects: Code that uses field names; the change check reports any change of case.

notes.observation: `AssessmentKey` is text in `StockSettings` and `StockDownload`, and a number in `StockList`, `SummaryTable`, `StockStatusValues` and `FishStockReferencePoints`. In the documentation the `assessmentKey` parameter is text for `FishStockReferencePoints` and the image endpoints, and an integer elsewhere.
notes.affects: Joining results from different endpoints on `AssessmentKey`.

notes.observation: `Status` has surrounding spaces (`" Published "`). Numbers such as `StockKey` and `StockDatabaseID` are returned as text.
notes.affects: Comparisons on these fields need `trimws()` or conversion.

notes.observation: The documentation gives the base path `/sag_api`, icesSAG uses `/SAG_API`; both work. Parameter names are not case sensitive (icesSAG sends `SAGChartKey`, the documentation has `sagChartKey`).

The API root (`/SAG_API/`) shows a default ASP.NET page; the documentation is at `/sag_api/docs/swagger/`. It lists `PublishSag/Run` and `PublishSag/Test` as GET operations, which are not called by this check.
